title: Inkk 0.1.1
release_notes:
Welcome to Inkk!
- Copy & Paste handwriting strokes and canvas objects (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V, Ctrl+X, Ctrl+D)
- Move & reorder pages with dedicated controls and shortcuts (Alt+Up / Alt+Down)
- Whiteboard space-pan: Hold Space and drag to navigate whiteboard view freely
- Select All (Ctrl+A) and quick context menu actions
